name: A POS sale linked to a UnitCost record must be costed, match that UnitCost record's SKU, currency, reference, and unit cost, and occur on or after its effective date.

payload.rationale: A POS sale linked to a UnitCost record must be costed, match that UnitCost record's SKU, currency, reference, and unit cost, and occur on or after its effective date.

response.expression: (((((self.cost_status == 'costed') and (self.sku_id == self.cost_record.sku_id)) and (self.currency == self.cost_record.currency)) and ((self.costed_ref ?? '') == self.cost_record.cost_ref)) and ((self.applied_unit_cost ?? -1) == self.cost_record.unit_cost)) and (timestamp(self.cost_record.effective_from) <= timestamp(self.sold_at))
